description: SearchFit tracks how a brand appears in AI assistant answers and helps close the gaps. See whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI mention your brand for the questions buyers actually ask, and how you compare with competitors. From there, generate and publish articles to a connected CMS, research keywords, audit a site for technical problems, and report on Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 alongside AI visibility. Requires a SearchFit account with at least one brand.

defaultPrompt: How does my brand show up in ChatGPT answers compared to my competitors?
Write an article for the AI search prompt my brand is losing
Create last month's performance report from Search Console and Google Analytics.
